subject: Packaging options: tier-swap timing, feature 'parachute', and SLA exception
messages:
From: Claire Ng <claire@nexwell.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@nexwell.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging question — mid-quarter tier swaps & keeping premium features after downgrade

Ben —

Thanks for taking a look. Attached is our RFP (short version) and a high-level wish list. Two things are tripping up our procurement and product teams: 1) we need the ability to swap tiers mid-quarter without a long billing delay, and 2) when we need to step down a tier, certain premium features (notably the LLM safety/scoring bundle and longer KV cache retention) must remain available during a transition window — call it a "feature parachute."

High-level constraints:
- We start a pilot July 1 (2-week ramp), want the option to upgrade to dedicated capacity by Aug 15 if latency hits target.
- If we downgrade later, we need the parachute to keep the safety + KV retention for up to 90 days, so our data pipelines can rework integration.
- Procurement needs visible proration and a clear SLA exception process for the pilot.

Can Redwood map packaging options that cover: a) quick tier-swap with proration, b) a paid feature-parachute add-on, and c) what an SLA exception for a 60–90 day pilot would look like? Also, can you share a proposed pricing XLS?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 30-min call this week (Wed/Thu morning PST).

—Claire Ng
Head of Product, NexWell Health
Attachment: NexWell_RFP_2026.pdf (application/pdf, 320 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Ng <claire@nexwell.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@nexwell.ai>, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question — mid-quarter tier swaps & keeping premium features after downgrade

Claire — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP. Short answer: yes, we can cover all three items but there are tradeoffs across cost and roll-back complexity.

Quick summary of options (high-level):

1) Tier-swap with automated proration
   - Immediate routing: you can swap tiers mid-billing-cycle; charges prorate to the day.
   - Limitation: feature availability is tied to the plan unless you add an escape clause.

2) Feature-parachute (new add-on concept)
   - Short-term add-on that preserves selected premium features (safety scoring, extended KV retention, advanced tracing) for a 60/90/120-day window after downgrade.
   - Price: adds a fixed monthly charge + per-token uplift while active.

3) Pilot SLA exception + Dedicated ramp
   - We can offer a time-limited SLA bump for pilot workloads (higher uptime target, priority routing) if you commit to a short-term reserved capacity conversion trigger (e.g., convert within 45 days).

I'll loop in our packaging lead (Olga) and pricing (Karthik) to put numbers against the options and draft a proposed quote XLS.

Proposed next steps:
- Internal: Olga / Karthik to draft two price scenarios (60d and 90d parachute) + SLA exception language.
- External: 30-min call Fri 9:30–10:00 AM PST to review options and confirm pilot gate.

Attaching: redwood-pack-comparison.png (image/png, 48 KB)

Thanks,
Ben
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: draft pricing for NexWell parachute options

Ben / Karthik —

I put together a concise approach for the two parachute windows Claire asked about. Attaching a quick XLS (will populate numbers after we align on the pilot SLA). Key points:

- 60-day parachute: lower fixed fee, per-token uplift + limit of 500k extra tokens at parachute rate.
- 90-day parachute: higher fixed fee, per-token uplift, unlimited KV retention within pilot quotas.
- Proration model: day-accurate proration when tier swaps occur; credits applied to the following billing cycle for downgrades in the same month.
- SLA exception: we can offer a temporary 99.9% uptime SLA for pilot if NexWell commits to a conversion trigger (conversion window: 45 days), with an agreed rollback clause.

Open items for pricing sheet:
- Exact per-token uplift (% vs host tier) — need Karthik to propose numbers.
- Pilot capacity sizing — need Tom's expected RPS and token mix.

I'll prepare two rows in the XLS for Claire: 60d and 90d parachute, plus an optional dedicated pilot line. File: nexwell-proposed-pricing.xlsx

—Olga
Sr. Product Manager, Packaging & Commercials
Attachment: nexwell-proposed-pricing.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 24 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Ng <claire@nexwell.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@nexwell.ai>, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question — mid-quarter tier swaps & keeping premium features after downgrade

Claire —

Thanks again. Per our internal alignment, here are three pragmatic packaging pathways for NexWell. I kept the language simple for procurement. The attached XLS has row-level pricing; below is the plain-English summary and the ask from your side.

Option A — Prorated Tier Swap (standard)
- What: Swap tiers any time; charges prorate to the day you switch.
- Feature behavior: features follow the target tier automatically (no parachute).
- When to use: short smooth upgrades where you want immediate routing change.

Option B — Feature-Parachute Add-on (recommended for safe downgrades)
- What: Preserve selected premium features for a limited window (60 or 90 days) after downgrade.
- Pricing: fixed monthly parachute fee + per-token uplift while active (see XLS).
- Limits: 60d option caps the protected token quota; 90d option removes the token cap and preserves KV retention.
- When to use: when you need a guaranteed transition window for integrations and audits.

Option C — Dedicated Pilot + SLA Exception (for latency-critical pilot)
- What: Short-term reserved capacity with a temporary SLA increase (99.9%) while pilot is on the reserved conversion path.
- Commitment: pilot must convert within the 45-day trigger window to keep exception; otherwise, standard SLA applies.
- When to use: if latency and throughput are primary gating factors and you want clear upgrade guarantees.

Next steps / Ask from NexWell:
1) Confirm target parachute window (60 vs 90 days) and expected token volume for protected features.
2) Share expected RPS and avg tokens per request for the pilot so we can finalize the Dedicated pilot sizing.
3) Pick a 30-min slot next week to review the attached pricing XLS. We have Fri 9:30–10:00 AM PST reserved as an option; let me know if that works or propose another time.

Attachments: nexwell-proposed-pricing.xlsx; redwood-pack-comparison.png
